submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image1 only, one whole native1254x1254 RGBA sprite on true transparent background. Image1 is the exact Moon Shadow Girl animation frame to edit. Image2 is the user-approved Bamboo Girl same-direction motion reference ONLY for lower-body orientation and shoe perspective; do not copy her identity, bow, costume or exact frame phase. Image3 is approved painted project style. Keep image1's silver short hair, purple eyes, navy ivory gold costume, crescent boots, two hands each holding its own curved crescent dagger, ornaments, upper-body pose, scarf, camera, canvas placement, figure size, and original stride phase. Do not swap left/right legs or move the stance to the other foot. No mirror, crop, zoom, recenter, full-body translation, new floor, shadow, text, effects or extra limbs. Return only the complete transparent sprite, with anatomical redraw confined to pelvis and lower legs where needed to correct direction, keeping existing foot contact height and natural bend.
Image1 runs straight SOUTH toward the viewer. Its screen-RIGHT support thigh/shin splays sideways to the right and the boot yaws away. Correct the screen-right thigh, knee, shin and boot into a natural near-vertical forward-running track under that hip, as image2's south pose. Knee and toe face straight toward the viewer, no diagonal outward foot or sideways push. Preserve the screen-left raised knee/foot's identity and phase, and keep it also facing forward. Keep a natural small gap between the two leg tracks; do not cross feet or merge knees. Existing support boot stays at the same contact height, but may shift inward only enough to remove the sideways splay. Keep the same raised-versus-support legs, original upperbody and both dagger hand poses exactly.
